items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: we had Carmen Leggio and Flossie, I forget Flossie's last name, but he plays the tenor and she plays the trumpet and flute. And they're going to play for us.

ctx.x: Is it going to be at N.Y.U. Law School?

Yeah, N.Y.U. School of Law. At our last Jazz Party, which was our annual meeting in July, we had Carmen Leggio and Flossie, I forget Flossie's last name, but he plays the tenor and she plays the trumpet and flute. And they're going to play for us. And allot of the musicians from Ryans promised that they would drop in and sit in, so we always have some extra guests. We tell them to bring their axes. And of course we serve a little wine and snacks and have a combination meeting and jazz concert. And the proceeds…
